title: The science of shopping
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Which parts of a shop's design most influence what customers buy?
Have you ever bought something simply because it was placed near the checkout?
Is it manipulative to use music, smell, lighting, or store layout to increase spending?
Why do people often buy more when they are given too many choices rather than too few?
If you designed a store to help customers make better decisions, what would you change?
